title: SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell says the company aims to build out ground-based infrastructure to complement its satellite network for "a true mobile service" (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell says the company aims to build out ground-based infrastructure to complement its satellite network for “a true mobile service” — SpaceX (SPCX.O) said on Tuesday that quarterly revenue nearly doubled and operating losses narrowed sharply …
